verdict.rationale: Omnara does have a GitHub connection flow (implied by the OAuth callback in comm-19), suggesting some repo-connect capability exists, but the only hands-on evidence of it shows a broken OAuth redirect_uri error rather than a smooth one-click setup. There is no first-party documentation describing a simple 'one-click' repo install; docs instead describe agent setup via YAML config, CLI, dashboard, or SDK, and MCP-server connections for external services, not repository access specifically. missing for 10: explicit docs/marketing describing a one-click repo-connect flow, independent confirmation that GitHub connection works without errors, details on repo permission scoping.
